findings.title: The Grand: Nad Al Sheba Gardens
findings.summary: Fully-leased community mall begins phased opening on 19 Aug 2026, anchored by the first Waitrose & Partners in Nad Al Sheba, alongside MMI, Al Jaber Optical and wellness/healthcare tenants.

findings.title: South Bay Mall
findings.summary: ~200,000 sq ft of shopping, dining and leisure across ground, first and rooftop levels; 60 retail units, a food hall, clubhouse, gym, spa and clinic planned overlooking the South Bay lagoon.

findings.title: Le Meryeme Mall (Liwan) & The Villa Mall
findings.summary: Two Spanish-inspired luxury malls (~113,700 sq ft and ~124,000 sq ft) in Wadi Al Safa 2, featuring retail, dining, rooftop pools and wellness zones; both slated for H2 2026.

findings.title: The Avenues – Riyadh
findings.summary: 1.8m sqm built-up area, ~370,000 sqm GLA comprising a large mall and five towers; targeted to open by Q4 2026.

findings.title: Riyadh retail market growth
findings.summary: Knight Frank forecasts Riyadh's retail space to grow 28% to 4.6 million sqm by 2026, underscoring continued pipeline expansion in the capital.

findings.title: The Way Mall & POINT HUB Mall
findings.summary: TIG Developments launches two new mall projects with combined investment exceeding EGP1.5bn for H2 2026. The Way Mall sits on a 1,680 sqm plot in Badr City near the Russian University.

findings.title: Downtown Souq: Al Khor
findings.summary: New mall opened in Al Khor, becoming the city's second shopping destination after Al Khor Mall (2012); features 300+ retail outlets, a 1,000 sqm entertainment area and 20 F&B outlets.

findings.title: Qatar Outlet Village
findings.summary: Billed as the "world's first outdoor air-conditioned mall", 100+ global luxury boutiques, waterside dining and a festival plaza across ~150,000 sqm; set to open in 2026.

findings.title: Aventura Mall
findings.summary: Construction 96% complete; project loan financing upsized to help complete the mixed-use lifestyle destination (shopping mall + residential). Opening targeted H2 2026.

findings.title: S3 Investment Opportunity
findings.summary: PPP with Kuwait's Public Authority for Housing Welfare (PAHW) for a traditional souk, regional mall and 110-key Hampton by Hilton hotel.

findings.title: Al Khobar mall: Saudi Downtown Company
findings.summary: PIF-backed Saudi Downtown Company signs agreement to develop a new shopping mall in Al Khobar, part of the Kingdom's urban-centre revitalisation push. Cross-reference Cenomi Centers item in Section B below.

findings.title: Baniyas digital mall & hypermarket
findings.summary: Lulu partners with Al Lul Group to build a digital mall and a 70,000 sq ft hypermarket in Baniyas, targeted for completion end-March 2026.

findings.title: Cenomi Centers
findings.summary: Signs deal with PIF-backed Saudi Downtown Company to develop a major destination in Al Khobar, extending the Kingdom's downtown-regeneration retail push.

findings.title: Majid Al Futtaim
findings.summary: Discontinues Carrefour operations in Kuwait and Bahrain; launches new HyperMax flagship grocery retail brand in Bahrain.

findings.title: Majid Al Futtaim / Midar
findings.summary: Partnership with Egypt's Midar for Investment and Urban Development to build a $3.1bn mixed-use development in Mada City, New Cairo, witnessed by the Egyptian PM.

findings.title: Chalhoub Group
findings.summary: Inaugurates a regional fulfilment centre in Riyadh's free zone near King Khalid International Airport, designed to enable 90-minute deliveries to major Saudi cities; also progressing Level Shoes' planned Miami flagship and a stake in designer Willy Chavarria.

findings.title: Chalhoub Group
findings.summary: Signs solar lease agreement with Yellow Door Energy, supporting the group's net-zero-by-2040 target; solar project construction expected complete early 2026.

findings.title: Lulu International Holdings
findings.summary: Signs strategic MoU with the UAE Food Cluster at "Make it in the Emirates 2026" (ADNEC, Abu Dhabi) to champion "Made in UAE" food products across its retail network.

findings.title: Lulu International Holdings
findings.summary: Launches Phase 2 of its Al Tayeb food-processing facility in Abu Dhabi, expanding local food-manufacturing capacity.

findings.title: Mabanee
findings.summary: Hilton Kuwait Resort renovation (331-key beachfront resort, JV with Touristic Enterprises Company) reaches 39% completion; reopening targeted H2 2026.

watch: Majid Al Futtaim governance claim. Reports of a June 2026 Dubai-government board takeover (new chair Fadel Abdulbaqi Al Ali) could not be corroborated on a Category A/B source and resembles a story previously traced to June 2025. Needs direct verification against MAF official channels before inclusion as fact.
Qatar Outlet Village. "World's first outdoor air-conditioned mall" claim lacks a confirmed opening date or primary-source corroboration, track for firm 2026 opening announcement.

TIG Developments (Egypt), The Way Mall / POINT HUB Mall. Sourced from a single regional aggregator with an unverified exact publication date; seek confirmation via Egypt-focused Category B media (Daily News Egypt, Enterprise) before next report.

Cenomi Centers, Al Khobar destination. Cross-reference the Maaal item against the Saudi Downtown Company / Construction Week Online piece to confirm whether these describe the same transaction or two separate Al Khobar mall projects.
Aldar, Marsa Al Saadiyat launches. AED100bn Saadiyat Island masterplan launches were flagged in H2 2026 guidance; watch for the first formal sales/launch announcement.
The Grand (Nad Al Sheba Gardens). Phased opening scheduled 19 Aug 2026, confirm on-the-day opening coverage closer to the date.
